name: OKAMOTO INDIA PRIVATE LIMITED
india_angle: Okamoto India Private Limited is actively participating in SEMICON India 2025, indicating a strategic focus on the Indian semiconductor market.
summary: Okamoto India Private Limited specializes in precision grinding technology, providing equipment for wafer thinning, surface grinding, and CMP processes. They focus on handling hard-to-process materials like SiC and GaN, supporting high-performance production in power semiconductors and advanced packaging applications.
